DreamsOutposts.OutpostFacilityDef.label: cultural center
DreamsOutposts.OutpostFacilityDef.description: A place for sermons, debate and organized cultural instruction.\n\nOperating requirement: at least one non-downed adult colonist at this outpost who follows the colony's primary ideoligion and has Social 5 or higher, plus at least one resident of another ideoligion to instruct. The qualified colonist with the highest conversion power becomes the guide. Every eligible resident is indoctrinated independently, with their own 2-day cycle; when a resident's cycle completes, the guide makes one normal-strength conversion attempt using vanilla conversion rules. All cycles pause while there is no qualified guide or the facility is disabled.
